dedupe_keys.name: wfp food market locations markets monitored for staple food prices

description: This dataset lists the markets where the World Food Programme collects staple food prices, with each market's name, country, administrative area and coordinates. WFP's vulnerability analysis and mapping unit uses these markets for its country price bulletins and the quarterly Market Monitor, which track cereals, pulses and other staples and the cost of the basic food basket. Coverage is the countries where WFP monitors prices, mostly low and middle income countries in Africa, Asia, the Middle East and Latin America, as a snapshot refreshed about monthly on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. The file is a free Excel download under the Creative Commons Attribution licence. Caveats: it gives locations only, without market size, opening days, trader numbers or supply routes, the set of markets changes as monitoring programmes start and stop, and coordinates are approximate for some towns. Simulation uses: placing market nodes in food supply network and agent-based models, linking price series to locations for disruption analysis, and checking which markets are exposed to floods, droughts or conflict. Related records: WFP global food prices (data-wfp-global-food-prices) hold the price series collected at these markets, and WFP HungerMap LIVE (platform-wfp-hungermap-live) shows them alongside food security indicators.
